Welcome to Day 4 of the Google AI Agent Intensive Course!
In this video, we dive deep into Agent Debugging and Evaluation — two skills every AI builder must master.

You’ll learn step-by-step:

🐞 How to debug your AI agents using the ADK Web UI

⚙️ How to interpret logs, traces, and error messages

📊 How to perform systematic evaluation of your agent’s performance

📚 How to use user simulation to test real-world scenarios

💡 The core debugging pattern: Symptom → Logs → Root Cause → Fix

We’ll build a Research Paper Finder Agent, intentionally break it 😅, then fix it live while understanding every line of code.

This video continues our journey from Day 1 to Day 4 — making complex ADK concept

video.description:
Luciq (formerly Instabug) | A practical guide to using execution traces to diagnose performance issues in your mobile app.

Execution traces show you exactly what your app is doing at a code level during a slow or failing session. In this video, we walk through how to read and use execution traces inside Luciq to get to the root cause faster.

Luciq is the pioneer of Agentic Mobile Observability. Formerly known as Instabug, Luciq's AI agents proactively detect, diagnose, and resolve mobile app issues before they reach users.

Learn more: https://luciq.ai
Book a demo: https://luciq.ai/request-demo

review.review: Demonstrates basic execution trace start/end APIs and dashboard latency metrics. Too generic for advanced software factory agent traces.
issues: General APM tracing tutorial rather than coding agent iterative loop trace analysis.
